milestones.title: M0 — Trusted Core
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 0. SQLite schema and constraints, run state machine, managed write guard, candidate snapshot, verification command contract, outbox and idempotency.

milestones.title: M1 — One Safe Project Run
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 1. Registries, primary CTO binding, dispatch, resource receipts and claims, verification sandbox, mandatory blind review, final CEO packet.

milestones.title: M2 — GitHub Integration Kernel
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 2. Trusted credential, PR prepare, gate publish, merge and post-merge, tag, hotfix, rollback, issue projection.

milestones.title: M3 — Dynamic Runtime
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 3. CTO create/replace/handoff/suspend/recovery, watchdog, doctor, session and process reconcile.

milestones.title: M4 — Capacity and Continuity
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 4. Provider quota buckets, RoleCoveragePlan, atomic failover and message fencing, restoration.

milestones.title: M5 — Repo Factory Integration
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 5. PROJECT_BOOTSTRAP, BOOTSTRAP_CTO, RepoFactoryResult validation, activation, handoff, doctor.

milestones.title: M6 — Interfaces, Telemetry, Acceptance
milestones.description: PRD §41 Slice 6 plus §28 interfaces. MCP, CLI, Buzz, Telegram, daemon, B-lite telemetry, CP-S01..CP-S59 scenario suite, end-to-end acceptance and traceability.

tickets.title: Repository scaffold, strict TypeScript, vitest, CI
tickets.acceptance: pnpm typecheck and pnpm test run clean on an empty suite; CI workflow present per PRD §36.

tickets.title: Core primitives: canonical digest, ids, clock, stable reason codes
tickets.acceptance: Canonical JSON is key-order independent; every denial path has a reason code from a single enum; remote identity normalization covers ssh/https/non-GitHub.

tickets.title: SQLite schema with every §30.2 hard constraint
tickets.acceptance: All eleven §30.1 tables plus justified additions exist; each §30.2 constraint has a negative test that trips it.

tickets.title: Database access layer with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and constraint translation
tickets.acceptance: Every §30.3 section runs in one transaction; a constraint violation surfaces as its stable reason code, not SQLITE_CONSTRAINT.

tickets.title: Append-only audit log with secret and transcript redaction
tickets.acceptance: Audit rows cannot be updated; secret-shaped keys are redacted and prompt/transcript keys are not stored.

tickets.title: Run state machine per §29.2
tickets.acceptance: Exactly the documented transitions are legal; terminal states are immutable; illegal transitions return RUN_TRANSITION_ILLEGAL.

tickets.title: Managed Write Guard (CP-HI-01)
tickets.acceptance: The guard classifies from operation plus resolved target path; a DIRECT-labelled mutation inside a git work tree is denied without a valid managed run identity.

tickets.title: Outbox with idempotency and fenced envelopes
tickets.acceptance: Replayed enqueue is suppressed; only the currently active generation is deliverable; a stale-generation ack is audit-only.

tickets.title: Candidate snapshot: freeze, digest, staleness
tickets.acceptance: Digest is stable for identical content across time; a moved head, changed tree or dirty work tree in any repository makes the whole snapshot stale.

tickets.title: Verification command contract and isolated sandbox execution
tickets.acceptance: argv-only commands; secrets absent from the child environment; network denied when declared; writes confined to the worktree; timeout kills the process group; unavailable confinement fails closed.

tickets.title: Project registry with derived activity and separate availability
tickets.acceptance: Activity is computed from primary CTO binding presence and is never stored; availability is independent.

tickets.title: Repository registry, local binding, drift and temporary registration
tickets.acceptance: Absolute checkout paths exist only in the registry; a committed manifest containing one is rejected; an unregistered repo gets a run-scoped temporary binding and no automatic project.

tickets.title: Session registry and lifecycle with derived BUSY
tickets.acceptance: Lifecycle is exactly STARTING/READY/DRAINING/STOPPED/ERROR; BUSY is derived from owned active runs and is not persisted.

tickets.title: Role binding, monotonic generation, revoke and transactional switch
tickets.acceptance: At most one active binding per role key and one active primary CTO per project; generation is monotonic; switch and outbox fencing happen in one transaction.

tickets.title: Global resource claim registry with lease and hard rejects
tickets.acceptance: Same worktree, same branch, exact declared path and revoked owner generation are hard rejects; semantic conflict is advisory only.

tickets.title: Provider runtime adapters: claude, codex, and a scripted adapter for deterministic tests
tickets.acceptance: Real adapters spawn the real CLIs; the scripted adapter is a distinct provider id and cannot be selected by a production routing path.

tickets.title: Run engine: create, dispatch admission, owner pinning, priority, cancel
tickets.acceptance: Owner session, incarnation and generation are pinned at admission; a project with no primary CTO auto-creates one; runs queue while the CTO drains.

tickets.title: Dynamic task graph, dependency validation and execution receipts
tickets.acceptance: Cycles are rejected; readiness follows dependencies; start and finish receipts are emitted automatically without per-second reporting.

tickets.title: Verification engine: profile resolution, execution, completeness gate, CI trust
tickets.acceptance: Missing command, missing repo, null result, stale CI head or truncated output blocks success; a CI result for a different head is rejected.

tickets.title: Mandatory independent blind review gate
tickets.acceptance: Automatically invoked after verification passes in every mode; producer sessions cannot be bound as reviewer; PASS requires zero omissions and full file coverage; REVISE returns to the CTO with no CEO notification.

tickets.title: Production-ready packet, CEO decision and notification policy
tickets.acceptance: Confirm is bound to the exact candidate snapshot and voided if it changes; only READY_FOR_CEO_REVIEW, true escalation and critical failure notify Hermes.

tickets.title: Trusted credential store confined to the daemon process
tickets.acceptance: The credential is reachable only from the daemon; no agent, verification or adapter environment can observe it.

tickets.title: Branch contract model and pr_prepare
tickets.acceptance: The Integration §9.2 matrix is machine-checked; a PR whose base or target violates the contract is refused.

tickets.title: gate_publish with payload binding and local provenance record
tickets.acceptance: Only the daemon publishes acp-production-gate; a same-named check from any other creator or with a mismatched payload is rejected.

tickets.title: merge_evaluate predicates and idempotent merge_execute
tickets.acceptance: All §24.5 predicates are enforced; stale base or head is refused; a replayed merge returns the original receipt without a second merge.

tickets.title: post_merge_verify, release_tag, hotfix propagation, rollback_prepare
tickets.acceptance: Merge API success is not completion; a failed post-merge check blocks dependents; wrong-commit or duplicate tags are refused; a hotfix missing from an active release reports propagation incomplete.

tickets.title: issue_project idempotent ticket projection
tickets.acceptance: Marker-based projection syncs title, body, labels and milestone idempotently; the ticket file stays the portable contract.

tickets.title: CTO lifecycle: create, drain, structured handoff, ACK, replace, suspend, resume, recovery takeover
tickets.acceptance: Switchover only at zero active runs; the old binding survives until HANDOFF_ACK; recovery takeover makes late results from the old generation audit-only.

tickets.title: Lightweight watchdog over overdue runs, tasks, sessions and claims
tickets.acceptance: A cheap timer inspects only overdue resources and triggers a scoped doctor; no permanent full-system scan.

tickets.title: Doctor scope, finding contract, deterministic aggregation and the repair operation contract
tickets.acceptance: Doctor is read-only and aggregates per §25.5; repair requires an allowlisted operation with preconditions, dry run and authorization; data-loss risk requires the owner.

tickets.title: Provider capacity probes, multi-bucket model, three-signal health and admission
tickets.acceptance: Sensor, runtime and admission are independent; refresh is event-driven at the six mandatory points; a stale or failed probe suspends new allocation rather than routing on UNKNOWN.

tickets.title: RoleCoveragePlan computed before any failover
tickets.acceptance: Produces FULL/PARTIAL/NO_VALID_COVERAGE with an action; Grok absence alone never degrades; SURVIVAL forbids production-ready completion.

tickets.title: Atomic failover, message fencing and non-preemptive restoration
tickets.acceptance: Activate, route switch, revoke and outbox retarget happen in one transaction; a recovered provider never takes an in-flight owner or reviewer.

tickets.title: RepoFactoryResult input contract and overclaim rejection
tickets.acceptance: repo-factory.result.v2 parses; a result asserting CTO assignment, Buzz, doctor, blind review, CEO confirm or project ACTIVE is rejected; a manifest digest mismatch reports BOOTSTRAP_CONTRACT_DRIFT.

tickets.title: PROJECT_BOOTSTRAP run, BOOTSTRAP_CTO binding and ACPBootstrapActivationResult
tickets.acceptance: Only the activation result completes the run; bootstrap CTO promotion is refused if that session reviewed the run; activation covers registration, binding, review, confirm, Buzz, handoff ACK and doctor.

tickets.title: Hermes MCP surface
tickets.acceptance: Exactly the §28.1 operations; every mutation carries a run id and an idempotency key.

tickets.title: CTO MCP surface
tickets.acceptance: Exactly the §28.2 operations; blind review and gate publish are absent by construction.

tickets.title: agentctl CLI
tickets.acceptance: doctor, run show, run cancel, continuity status, outbox retry, owner approve, repair dry-run/execute.

tickets.title: Buzz adapter with actor-to-binding mapping
tickets.acceptance: Buzz actor and session ids map to active role bindings; a display name alone grants nothing.

tickets.title: Telegram ingress with allowlist, authenticity and replay defence
tickets.acceptance: Non-allowlisted user or chat is refused; a replayed update is idempotently ignored; forwarded content is treated as data.

tickets.title: agentcpd daemon: single-instance lock, supervision, restart reconciliation, crash-loop backoff
tickets.acceptance: A second instance refuses to start; restart reloads bindings, runs, outbox and claims and resumes dispatch without duplication.

tickets.title: B-lite telemetry over the controlled vocabulary
tickets.acceptance: Run, task, quality, capacity, graph and continuity metrics are recorded; missing telemetry is reported as missing and never imputed.

tickets.title: Scenario suite CP-S01..CP-S59
tickets.acceptance: Every scenario in §39 has an executable test asserting the documented outcome.

tickets.title: End-to-end acceptance on a manually registered real project and requirement traceability report
tickets.acceptance: The full User→Hermes→ACP→CTO→workers→verification→blind review→packet→confirm path runs against a real repository; a generated report maps every P0 requirement to implementation and evidence.
